items.prompt: A small one-room Moscow flat at night. A man seen from behind sits at a narrow kitchen table writing in a brand-new notebook under a single lamp. Through the window, in fog, the hyperboloid steel lattice of the Shukhov radio tower. Books stacked on the floor, a mug with a broken handle. Still, tired, very late.

alt.ru: Ночь, однокомнатная квартира: мужчина спиной к нам пишет в новом блокноте под одной лампой, за окном в тумане решётка Шуховской башни.
alt.en: Night in a one-room flat: a man with his back to us writes in a new notebook under a single lamp, the lattice of the Shukhov tower in the fog outside.
alt.pt: Noite num apartamento de um quarto: um homem de costas escreve num caderno novo sob uma única lâmpada; lá fora, na névoa, a treliça da torre Chukhov.
alt.es: Noche en un apartamento de una habitación: un hombre de espaldas escribe en un cuaderno nuevo bajo una sola lámpara; fuera, en la niebla, la celosía de la torre Shújov.

items.prompt: A cramped, shabby Russian research-institute laboratory. In the centre hangs the open golden chandelier of a quantum computer's dilution refrigerator: stacked plates, coiled cables, gleaming tubes. To one side a woman in a checked shirt, seen from behind, sits at three monitors with waveforms. Peeling paint, a dead fluorescent tube, a kettle on a filing cabinet. The cryostat is the brightest object.

alt.ru: Тесная институтская лаборатория: в центре висит раскрытая «люстра» криостата квантового процессора, сбоку женщина в клетчатой рубашке спиной к нам у трёх мониторов.
alt.en: A cramped institute lab: the open 'chandelier' of a quantum processor's cryostat hangs in the middle, a woman in a checked shirt sits with her back to us at three monitors.
alt.pt: Um laboratório apertado de instituto: ao centro pende o 'lustre' aberto do criostato de um processador quântico; ao lado, uma mulher de camisa xadrez, de costas, diante de três monitores.
alt.es: Un laboratorio estrecho de instituto: en el centro cuelga la 'lámpara' abierta del criostato de un procesador cuántico; a un lado, una mujer con camisa de cuadros, de espaldas, frente a tres monitores.

items.prompt: A Moscow avenue in November at six in the evening. Fine drizzle hangs in the air like suspended dust; every streetlamp wears a halo. Two figures walk away from us toward a distant metro entrance, one of them fighting a half-inverted umbrella. Wet asphalt reflects the lamps. Long, quiet perspective.

alt.ru: Московский проспект в ноябрьских сумерках: морось висит в воздухе, у фонарей ореолы, двое уходят к метро, один воюет с вывернутым зонтом.
alt.en: A Moscow avenue at November dusk: drizzle hangs in the air, haloes round the lamps, two people walk toward the metro, one fighting an inverted umbrella.
alt.pt: Uma avenida de Moscovo ao entardecer de novembro: a chuva miúda paira no ar, halos à volta dos candeeiros, duas pessoas caminham para o metro, uma luta com o guarda-chuva virado.
alt.es: Una avenida de Moscú al anochecer de noviembre: la llovizna flota en el aire, halos en las farolas, dos personas caminan hacia el metro, una pelea con un paraguas dado la vuelta.

items.prompt: Close-up of a kitchen table at night: an old paper photograph with a bent corner leans against a salt shaker. The photo shows a dark-haired woman, out of focus, her face indistinct, looking past the camera. Beside it a cup of tea going cold. Window light from the street, deep shadows.

alt.ru: Ночной кухонный стол: к солонке прислонена старая фотография с загнутым уголком, на ней размытая темноволосая женщина, рядом остывает чай.
alt.en: A kitchen table at night: an old photograph with a bent corner leans on a salt shaker, a blurred dark-haired woman in it, tea going cold beside it.
alt.pt: Uma mesa de cozinha à noite: uma fotografia antiga de canto dobrado encostada ao saleiro, nela uma mulher de cabelo escuro desfocada, ao lado um chá a arrefecer.
alt.es: Una mesa de cocina de noche: una foto antigua con la esquina doblada apoyada en el salero, en ella una mujer de pelo oscuro desenfocada, al lado un té que se enfría.
